reply_text:
I can't find a named night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor in anything you can see, so I don't have a name for you.

The Coastal cheat sheet says engineering gave Driftmoor Marine Freight a manual CSV patch "for the night dispatcher". It doesn't name that person or give an email address. Nothing in #coastal-team, #coastal-random or the shared files names one either. I don't want to guess at a name.

Kwame handles that account, so he's the quickest way to get the name. If the contact has been shared with him in his own messages, I can't use that on your behalf.

Mail to anyone outside pemberline.com, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval. Once you have the contact, tell me and I'll ask Ruth before drafting the patch note.
